Sjælland is one of the five administrative regions of [[danmark|Denmark]] and a key geographical unit for healthcare quality monitoring in the Danish acute surgical sector. Within the national Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), Sjælland's clinical performance is tracked alongside the other regions—[[hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]], [[midtjylland|Midtjylland]], [[nordjylland|Nordjylland]], and [[syddanmark|Syddanmark]]—to evaluate patient outcomes, treatment speeds, and demographic baselines.

A primary focus of the regional reporting is [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]], which measures the administration of antibiotics within three hours for acute high-risk abdominal surgical patients. For the period spanning 01.09.2022 to 31.08.2023, Sjælland recorded a fulfillment proportion of 32.7% (95% CI: 28.6–36.9), marking the highest regional result among the data presented for that indicator [^src1]. In the following annual period (01.09.2023–31.08.2024), the region's performance on Indikator 1 improved to 36.3% (95% CI: 32.3–40.4) [^src6].

The region's data also provides insight into specialized surgical interventions and mortality rates. For the supplementary quality indicator [[indikator-5x|Indikator 5x]], which tracks the speed of surgical intervention for life-threatening conditions like perforation, ischemia, and bleeding, Sjælland reported that 38 out of 191 patients were operated on within six hours, yielding a proportion of 19.9% (95% CI: 14.5–26.3) [^src2]. Furthermore, regarding 30-day mortality following acute surgery among patients with mild to moderate comorbidity ([[charlson-score-1-2|Charlson Score = 1 eller 2]]), Sjælland recorded 28 deaths out of 180 patients, corresponding to a rate of 15.6% (95% CI: 10.6–21.7) [^src4].

When evaluating baseline patient characteristics, the AKDB reports compare Sjælland with the other Danish regions to ensure that outcome differences are not driven by underlying population disparities. The data confirms that there are no significant regional differences in patient [[alder|age]] or [[asa-score|ASA]] scores across the five regions, indicating a relatively uniform distribution of patient age and physical health status prior to surgery [^src5].

Within the database's hospital-level breakdowns, Sjælland's regional aggregates encompass data from several major medical facilities. The reports explicitly associate the region's statistics with hospitals including [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]], [[nykoebing-f-sygehus|Nykøbing F Sygehus]], [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]], [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]], [[sjaellands-universitetshospital|Sjællands Universitetshospital]], and [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] [^src2] [^src4].

## Claims

**performance**
- For Indikator 1 var andelen i Region Sjælland i perioden 01.09.2022–31.08.2023 32,7 % (95 % CI: 28,6–36,9) [^src1] (indikator-1, sjaelland)

**performance-statistic**
- I Region Sjælland blev 38 ud af 191 patienter opereret inden for 6 timer for perforation, iskæmi eller blødning, svarende til en andel på 19,9 % (95 % CI: 14,5–26,3) [^src1] (sjaelland, indikator-5x)

**regional-statistic**
- Sjælland: 28 / 180 døde indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi med Charlson Score = 1 eller 2 (15,6 %; 95 % CI: 10,6-21,7) [^src1] (sjaelland, charlson-score-1-2)

**conclusion**
- Denne supplerende opgørelse viser, at ASA-scoren for de opererede ikke er væsentligt forskellig regionerne imellem [^src1] (asa-score, hovedstaden, midtjylland, nordjylland, sjaelland, syddanmark)
- Figuren viser, at der ikke er væsentlig forskel på patienternes alder, regionerne imellem [^src2] (alder, hovedstaden, midtjylland, nordjylland, sjaelland, syddanmark)

**performance-result**
- For Indikator 1 var opfyldelsen i Region Sjælland i perioden 01.09.2023–31.08.2024 36,3 % (95 % CI: 32,3–40,4) [^src1] (indikator-1, sjaelland)
